heading: BaadMay & truID: Secure Remote Customer Identity Verification
description: BaadMay, an emerging Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) startup, partnered with truID to implement secure remote customer identity verification.

overview.title: Overview
overview.content:
BaadMay, an emerging Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) startup, aspired to remotely verify its customers, anchoring its strategy on advanced identity verification mechanisms. To achieve this, BaadMay entered into collaboration with truID. The primary objective was to incorporate truID's online identity verification service within BaadMay's web and mobile apps.

This SaaS-based service from truID was expected to offer a suite of features, including liveness detection, ID document authenticity checks, photo-ID to selfie matching, and automatic text extraction using OCR.

The ID documents that truID was required to support included Smart CNIC, NICOP, POC, and Urdu ID cards. From these, specific details such as the ID number, name, father's name, date of birth, and date of expiry from Smart CNICs, PoC, and NICOP, and the ID number and date of issue from the Urdu ID cards were to be extracted automatically using OCR. Furthermore, BaadMay emphasized the importance of editing OCR outputs through an admin dashboard.

bullets.heading: Multi-Platform Integration
bullets.text: The service needed to integrate with both web and mobile applications.

bullets.heading: Support for Multiple ID Types
bullets.text: The system had to authenticate Smart CNIC, NICOP, POC, and Urdu ID cards.

bullets.heading: Automated Data Extraction
bullets.text: OCR was required to extract key data points accurately from all supported ID documents.

bullets.heading: Editable OCR Data
bullets.text: Extracted information needed to be editable by BaadMay's admin via the dashboard.

bullets.heading: Admin Oversight
bullets.text: Manual verification tools for suspicious cases and a comprehensive audit trail were expected.

bullets.heading: Performance & Reliability
bullets.text: 24x7 service availability with support during standard working hours (10 AM to 7 PM PST) was mandatory.

sections.title: Solution: Automated Online Identity Verification
sections.content: truID provided a SaaS-based online identity verification solution fully integrated into BaadMay's web and mobile apps. The solution included:

bullets.text: Liveness detection and ID document authenticity checks
Photo-ID to selfie matching
OCR-based extraction of essential data points from Smart CNIC, NICOP, POC, and Urdu ID cards
Editable OCR outputs via BaadMay admin dashboard
Return of digital copies of ID documents and extracted information to BaadMay
Admin dashboard with manual verification feature for suspicious cases
Comprehensive audit trail available to admins
Web SDK and Mobile SDK for seamless platform integration
High availability and dedicated support during standard working hours
Secure remote customer verification across web and mobile platforms
Support for multiple ID types: Smart CNIC, NICOP, POC, and Urdu ID cards
Automatic extraction of essential information using OCR
Editable OCR data via admin dashboard
Digital copies of ID documents returned to BaadMay
Manual verification capabilities for suspicious cases
Comprehensive audit trail for verification processes
24x7 service availability with dedicated support
Automated workflow leveraging AI, Computer Vision, and NLP

conclusion: truID enabled BaadMay to implement a fully automated, SaaS-based identity verification system for its web and mobile apps. The solution supported multiple ID types, returned digital copies of documents, offered editable OCR data, and provided admin oversight with manual verification and audit trail functionality. This ensured a secure, reliable, and user-friendly remote identity verification experience.

heading: Secure In-App Identity Verification
description: MyTM integrated truID's SaaS-based identity verification service to streamline both customer and agent onboarding.

overview.title: Overview
overview.content:
MyTM sought to integrate a SaaS-based online identity verification service from truID to enhance its mobile app functionalities for the onboarding of both its customers and agents. Specifically, the service was geared towards integration with both iOS and Android platforms.

For agent onboarding, the standard verification flow, including liveness detection, card verification, and photo-ID to selfie matching, was emphasized. In contrast, the customer onboarding process pivoted around biometric verification, where the user's fingerprints were captured via the mobile app and subsequently verified using the NADRA BioSys API.

truID was required to accommodate various Smart CNIC and Urdu CNIC card types for card authentication. An essential aspect of the service was the automatic extraction of specific data points from these ID documents through OCR, including the ID number, name, father's name, date of birth, and date of expiry from Smart CNICs, and the ID number and date of birth from Urdu CNICs.

bullets.heading: Support for Smart CNIC and Urdu CNIC
bullets.text: The system had to authenticate multiple card types and extract accurate data through OCR.

bullets.heading: Performance & Reliability

heading: Transforming Digital Onboarding with Touchless Biometric Identity Verification
description: Askari Bank partnered with truID to revolutionize digital account opening with Pakistan's first touchless fingerprint biometric verification.

overview.title: Overview
overview.content:
Askari Bank Limited (AKBL) partnered with truID, a comprehensive biometric identity verification platform and a NUST spin-off, to elevate its digital account opening experience. truID is Pakistan's only indigenous pioneer of touchless fingerprint biometrics, offering a complete suite of AI-powered verification capabilities including face liveness detection, ID–Selfie Matching, document authentication, CNIC OCR with Urdu transliteration, and smartphone-based touchless fingerprint capture without the need for hardware scanners.

For AKBL, truID delivered a customized Digital Account Opening App and SDK for both Android and iOS. This was integrated directly into the Askari Digital mobile application along with a fully on-premises identity verification service that aligns with State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) regulations.

truID's strong performance, including 96.6 percent overall accuracy, 99 percent face liveness detection, 91 percent first-attempt NADRA match, 93 percent document authentication accuracy, and more than 80 percent touchless fingerprint match success, enabled AKBL to offer a secure, smooth, and fully touchless onboarding experience.

To date, truID has completed more than 2.6 million verifications, including over 165,000 verifications for Askari Bank.

bullets.heading: Enable Fully Remote Account Opening
bullets.text: AKBL needed a digital onboarding solution that allowed customers to open accounts through the Askari Digital app without visiting a branch and without relying on hardware fingerprint scanners.

bullets.heading: Strengthen Identity Security and Ensure SBP Compliance
bullets.text: The solution required passive face liveness detection that prevents photo, video, and mask attacks; Identity document authenticity checks; CNIC OCR with Urdu text extraction; ID–Selfie facial matching; NADRA Verisys integration; Complete compliance with SBP digital KYC regulations.

bullets.heading: Support Multiple Government-Issued IDs
bullets.text: The bank needed accurate data extraction, transliteration, and document classification for Pakistani identity documents.

bullets.heading: Provide Administrative Oversight
bullets.text: AKBL required a platform that offered an audit trail, manual verification capabilities, and editable OCR fields.

bullets.heading: Reduce Hardware Dependency
bullets.text: The bank aimed to eliminate traditional biometric devices to lower operational costs and accelerate onboarding through touchless, camera-based fingerprints.

sections.title: Solution
sections.content: truID delivered a complete on-premises identity verification and digital onboarding framework tailored specifically for Askari Bank.

bullets.heading: Custom Digital Account Opening App and SDK
bullets.text: The mobile SDK was designed to match existing AKBL workflows and mirrors the functionality of the Digital Onboarding Web App; Integrates directly with the Askari Digital mobile application; Enables upload of customer signatures and proof of income; Supports FATCA checks; Guides users on nearest branch options, internet banking username preferences, and cheque book size selection; Provides account type recommendations based on bank policies; Offers modifiable OCR outputs for administrative corrections.

bullets.heading: truID On-Premises Identity Verification Service
bullets.text: Fully hosted inside AKBL's secure data environment, the verification service includes Facial Verification with Passive 3D liveness detection and ID–Selfie facial matching; Document Authentication and OCR with detection of forgery, tampering, and copy attacks with 93 percent accuracy, CNIC OCR with 95 percent accuracy, Urdu-to-English transliteration, and Automatic classification of identity documents.

bullets.heading: Touchless Fingerprint Biometrics
bullets.text: Using standard smartphone cameras: AI-driven fingerprint capture that requires no external devices; NIST NFIQ 2.0 compliant; Capture time between 1 and 5 seconds; More than 80 percent match success; 500 ppi output resolution; Complete offline capability; Up to 95 percent reduction in cost compared to traditional biometric scanners. Fingerprints and identity details are verified against the NADRA database through the NADRA Verisys API.

bullets.heading: Admin Dashboard
bullets.text: Manual verification for doubtful cases; Editable OCR fields; Full audit trail for every verification step.
Overall System Accuracy: 96.6%
NADRA Match Accuracy: 91% on first attempt

Delivered a fully touchless and frictionless digital onboarding experience
Enabled secure remote account opening without hardware biometric devices
Strengthened fraud detection through advanced liveness checks and document analysis
Achieved full SBP compliance across verification steps
Provided transparent workflows with detailed audit trails
Reduced operational costs significantly
Enabled scalable and user-friendly biometric onboarding for all customer types

conclusion: The partnership between Askari Bank and truID, a NUST spin-off, sets a new benchmark for digital onboarding in Pakistan. By integrating AI-driven facial liveness, ICAO photo verification, CNIC OCR, document authentication, and touchless fingerprint biometrics, AKBL now offers a secure and seamless digital account opening journey that eliminates hardware dependency. With its fully on-premises deployment, NADRA integration, and high verification accuracy, Askari Bank has successfully completed more than 165,000 verifications, contributing to truID's broader footprint of over 2.6 million identity checks across Pakistan. Askari Bank stands among the earliest adopters of fully touchless biometric onboarding in the country and continues to lead the industry with a secure, scalable, and future-ready digital identity infrastructure.

heading: Secure In-App Identity Verification

heading: Africa's Digital Identity Revolution: TruID Enabling Secure Biometric Verification
description: TruID is powering Africa's digital identity transformation across six key markets with over 350 million digital users.

overview.title: Overview
overview.content:
Africa's Digital Identity Revolution: TruID is at the forefront of Africa's digital-ID transformation, providing advanced biometric identity verification and document authentication solutions. Across six key African markets, over 350 million digital users require reliable verification, representing a multi-billion-dollar opportunity even at modest adoption levels.

TruID's solutions allow governments, banks, fintechs, and telcos to onboard users securely and compliantly anytime, anywhere. The platform combines facial and fingerprint verification, document authentication, liveness detection, OCR, and anti-spoofing intelligence to ensure trust in every transaction. Its modular SDKs and regional partnerships make integration seamless across web and mobile platforms.
